content.short: Liquidswap is the premier AMM decentralized exchange on Aptos, featuring high security via Move language.
content.description: Liquidswap is the definitive automated market maker (AMM) and decentralized exchange built on the Aptos blockchain by Pontem Network. Leveraging the high security and performance of the Move programming language, the platform offers a robust environment for asset swaps, including standard AMM pools for volatile assets and specialized stable swaps for correlated assets. Liquidswap serves as a primary liquidity hub, providing users with sub-second finality.
